## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `37684a55c127957e740a9a5c7dea6e940d8d86cd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/objectstack.md + none

PR #35363, card #35350 (`Part of`, the card's item 1 only). Net diff against `main` (merge-base `3819afeca1`): 2 files, 4 insertions, 4 deletions; both files keep their line counts (71, 35). No file in the diff implements or enforces the two `hits` files, so the scope ends at `hits`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Claim write set — narrows, right.** The area claim stops adding a per-area `lease:` label in the dispatch write and carries an `Area: AREA` line in the `Claim:` comment instead (`area-lease.md:37`). That is the card's item 1, second bullet, and the maintainer's ruling quoted on the card body.
- **Pre-claim leave-alone set — right.** `area-lease.md:30` keeps the other-assignee and other-`Claim:` signals and swaps the foreign label for another area's `Area:` line. Mutual exclusion does not weaken: `pm:dispatched` and the `Claim:` comment were already the claim state, and the label only named which area held it.
- **Post-claim read-back — right.** `area-lease.md:38` reads back `pm:dispatched` and the assignee, the two things the dispatch atomic pair writes; nothing is left that the read-back fails to check as a label.
- **Readers of the label family — none, confirmed in the tree at this head.** A grep of `lease:` over `.claude/**`, `scripts/pm/**`, `.github/**` and `AGENTS.md` leaves, apart from `Release:`-family lines and one prose comment about the token write lease in `fleet-token.mjs:521`, only the seeder in `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh:435-454`, a creator and not a reader. `.claude/**` has zero matches. No gate, workflow or half-state check loses an input.
- **No public surface.** Nothing under `packages/**`, no schema, no published skill (`skills/**`) is touched.
- **Gate verdicts.** Every non-skipped check-run on this head concluded `success`, including `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (line ratchet and id lint), `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `PR-body guards` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard`.

### ② Semver level

Nothing is published: the diff is two internal skill reference files under `.claude/**`. The PR carries `skip-changeset`, and `Check Changeset` concluded `success`. `Clause-②: no` is correct — no authorable metadata, no runtime behaviour and no package API changes. `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **open_questions 1 — the `ensure-pm-labels.sh` seeder (lines 435-456) still creates eight per-area labels and its header still says an area session hangs the label at claim.** Answered: option A. It stays out of this PR, which is correct for a skill-text-only `Part of` PR, and it must land on this card BEFORE the item-2 deletions, since a rerun of the vocabulary script would recreate the labels and the script header is the stated authority for label-object cleanup (SKILL.md's script table). Until then the card's Done-when is not met; the card rightly stays open. Routing of that one-file PR is the seat's.
- **Deviation 1 (local branch name differs from the pushed branch)** — no effect on the reviewed tree; the head is the one named above.
- **Deviation 2 (model-free commit trailers)** — follows AGENTS.md; nothing to answer.
- **Deviation 3 (the scripts/pm edit was refused and not retried)** — correct stop; covered by the answer above.
- **Out-of-scope note: the SKILL.md `Claim:` template has no `Area:` row.** Accepted as is: the `Pre-claim lane:`, `Pre-claim deps:` and `Prior rulings read:` lines are likewise taught only in `area-lease.md` and absent from the template, so the area-only line sits where its siblings sit. The card's own claim already carries the line and `PR-body guards` passed with it.
- **SQL push-down:** not applicable — no code, no query.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`area-lease.md` — read against the card's item 1 and against the files it cites on this head (`execution-duties.md` dispatch pair, the SKILL.md label-write steps and `Claim:` template, `lanes/objectstack.md:17`). The three edited lines say what the card orders, cite files that exist and still say what the lines rely on, and no other line in the file still depends on the label. Attempts to break it: (a) two areas of one seat share the account, so the assignee cannot tell them apart — holds anyway, `pm:dispatched` plus a foreign `Claim:` already stop the second claim, and `lanes/objectstack.md:17` reads 「他区」 as other seat or other area; (b) a claim parser rejecting an unknown line — the live claim on the card carries `Area:` and the claim guard is green; (c) a collision with the `area:` label family — that family is a label compare only, no reader takes it from a comment line.

`lanes/objectstack.md` — read against the same ruling and the lane's own neighbouring lines. Line 23 keeps the uniqueness and seat-prefix rule and drops the label sentence, as ordered.

- N1 (nit) — `area-lease.md:30` drops the card's qualifier 「in a live `Claim:`」: the re-read list is labels, assignee and the last comment, while the `Area:` line sits in the newest `Claim:`, which is seldom the last comment, and a released claim's `Area:` line is not live. Worst case is an area leaving a free card alone; the old label was staler still (a release never removed it). Accepted deviation or a wording touch on the item-2 follow-up.
- N2 (nit) — `lanes/objectstack.md:23` says the area name is recorded 「只」 in the lease table and the `Area:` line, while line 25 says area name and path roots live only in the lease table and line 27 has the area declared in a seat-post comment. The sense is clear (definition in the table, per-card mark in the claim); the 「只」 is one word too strong. Accepted deviation.
